name: cretan-cat
description: A pixel-art Cretan cat above the prompt, Manousos unless you name it. Clawd tells the cat what to do while Claude works, and it answers in song: Cretan mantinades, coplas and tangos, or English couplets.

name.title: Cretan cat: name
name.description: What the cat is called, up to 20 characters. /cat name <name> sets it too.

language.title: Cretan cat: Clawd's language
language.description: What Clawd says to the cat, and the cat's short replies: Greek, English, or Spanish as they speak it in Buenos Aires. /cat language sets it too.

songs.title: Cretan cat: songs
songs.description: What the cat sings while Claude works: Cretan mantinades (greek), English couplets, or payador coplas and tangos (spanish). /cat songs sets it too.

temper.title: Cretan cat: temper
temper.description: On, the cat may slap Clawd for nagging, swat your hand when petted, and sit on your keyboard until petted. /cat temper sets it too.

sound.title: Cretan cat: sound
sound.description: The cat's voice: a happy trill when the work is done or he gets a sardine, a questioning mew when Claude waits for you, a purr when petted, a hiss at failing tests or a swat. At most one sound every 2 seconds. Plays on macOS only.

resolution.title: Cretan cat: resolution
resolution.description: How finely the yard is drawn: low, two pixels a terminal cell, everywhere; high, a fine picture where the terminal shows pictures (kitty, Ghostty; not under tmux), cells elsewhere. /cat resolution sets it too.

ai.title: Cretan cat: AI songs and lines
ai.description: On, one small model call (Haiku) per turn writes the cat's song and Clawd's nudges for your prompt; it uses tokens, at most 100 calls a day. Only the prompt's topic words (anything like a key, email, URL, path or number taken out) and these settings are sent, never the prompt, files or transcript. /cat ai sets it too.
